description: Dish cards that each open the dish page; no cart.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A showcase of dishes: each card is one link to the dish page (picture, badge, name, weight, summary, price and
  an arrow). No cart here. Axes: cols (3, 4), ratio (4/3, 1/1), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

  export type DishShowcaseProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    cols?: "3" | "4";
    ratio?: "4/3" | "1/1";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    cols = "3",
    ratio = "4/3",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: DishShowcaseProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="star" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Grid cols={(((cols as string) === "4") ? "2-4" : "1-3")} class="gap-8" data-testid="items">
      {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
        <Link
          href={urlOf((d.href ?? tpl("#/dish/{0}", d.id)))}
          variant="block"
          class="group flex-col items-stretch gap-4"
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio={ratio} />
          <Stack gap="2">
            {#if d.badge}
              <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm" class="w-fit">
                {d.badge}
              </Badge>
            {/if}
            <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
              <Inline class="text-lg font-semibold">
                {d.name}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {d.weight}
              </Inline>
            </Group>
            <Inline class="text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground">
              {d.summary}
            </Inline>
            <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
              <Inline class="text-base font-bold">
                {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
              </Inline>
              <Inline class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary">
                {labels.open}
                <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
              </Inline>
            </Group>
          </Stack>
        </Link>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
